description: A terminal test reads the token that the terminal reads. T="ta" holds of the synthetic, whose saved sound is ta, so c is a second reading. Compare reparse-reference-sound-test (engine §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T U
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [T="ta"]
%rule b A [T="ta"] [U]
%rule c A T="ta"
